categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/addrman.cpp and carries the P2P label, modifying address sampling logic within addrman buckets.
categories.rationale: Fixes an extreme statistical bias in address selection that skews peer connectivity. As the description notes, sequential scanning from a random offset in sparse buckets resulted in massive selection skews (such as '95.3% versus 4.7% in a two-entry bucket'), which undermines uniform peer sampling and eclipse resistance.
